invariants.rationale: The method returns the result of handleInsert or handleUpdate, both of which likely guarantee non-null Iterators.
Partition must be non-null for getBucketInfo to succeed without NullPointerException.
partitioner must be non-null since it is cast to JavaUpsertPartitioner and used in getBucketInfo.
recordItr is passed to downstream methods and likely required to be non-null.
instantTime is a key method parameter and likely is required to be non-null for correct execution.
